origin: mechanistic hypothesis proposed after inspecting 2024-2025; future independent test required
source: BTCUSDT USD-M Futures H1 OHLCV and timestamped Binance USD-M public metrics, recorded with provenance and SHA-256 before evaluation
decision: hour boundary after the last closed H1 bar; latest metrics must have timestamp <= decision and age <=60 minutes; no imputation
baseline: Regime er20-vol20-vs-prior60-v1 structure=trend direction=up, all volatility levels
target: baseline AND OI rising versus the immediately prior consecutive valid hourly metric AND taker buy/sell ratio >1
comparator: baseline AND valid consecutive OI change and nonzero valid taker ratio AND NOT target
outcome: BTCUSDT futures next-hour open to horizon close simple return, same hours and venue in both arms
primary_null: target conditional mean minus comparator conditional mean <= 0
inference: joint calendar moving block max-t simultaneous 95% confidence intervals across five horizons, 168-hour blocks, 2000 resamples, seed 1729
pass_research_gate: 4h simultaneous lower bound >0, target 4h mean after fixed 0.001 round-trip cost >0, minimum N and calendar duration all satisfied
failure: any prerequisite absent or primary research gate fails; no retuning, no promotion
secondary_horizons: reported with same simultaneous intervals; no secondary horizon can rescue failed primary
promotion: research gate only; Criterion still requires independent replication, execution-cost/funding/slippage, risk and prospective governance gates
